screening_decisions.reason: Not an RCT - this is a before-and-after study with comparison villages that were too small to join the programme. No randomization described.
While this is an RCT, it tests malaria chemoprophylaxis administered BY TBAs, not TBA training itself. The intervention is the drug, not training.
Observational study comparing outcomes among women who happened to have trained TBA, tetanus toxoid, or neither. No randomization described.
Field trial with control area but randomization not clearly stated. Focuses on childhood pneumonia management, not pregnancy/birth outcomes.
This is a Cochrane review protocol/abstract, not a primary RCT.
Methodological paper about funnel plots and meta-analysis bias detection, not about TBA training.
Validation study of survey instruments for obstetric complications, not an RCT about TBA training.

RCT comparing two educational programs (lecture-style vs interactive problem-based) for TBAs. Fits 'additionally trained versus trained TBAs' criterion. Outcomes include knowledge, attitude, and practices.
Intervention and control villages selected but randomization not clearly stated. Primary focus is village health workers, with TBAs as part of a broader package.
Controlled study comparing communities with and without trained TBAs, but no randomization described. Communities were 'randomly selected' for interviews, not randomized to intervention.
Review/critique of another meta-analysis, not a primary RCT.

Cluster randomized controlled trial where birth attendants were cluster randomized to intervention (training in neonatal resuscitation + amoxicillin) or control (standard care). Directly compares trained vs untrained TBAs.
Narrative review article summarizing systematic reviews and meta-analyses, not a primary RCT.
Retrospective case record review at a tertiary hospital, not an RCT. No TBA involvement.
Time-series experimental study without randomization. TBAs given formal teaching but no control group with randomization.

Cluster-randomized controlled trial with seven subdistricts randomly assigned to intervention (TBA training + delivery kits + LHW linkage) or control (usual care). Compares areas with trained TBAs vs usual care.
Cluster RCT but main intervention is women's groups. All clusters received basic TBA training, so not comparing trained vs untrained TBAs.
Systematic review of causes of maternal death, not a primary RCT about TBA training.
Quasi-experimental design, not an RCT. Uses geographical area and time comparisons without randomization.
Cluster RCT but intervention is breastfeeding promotion through health/nutrition workers, not TBA training.
Longitudinal study with intervention and comparison areas, but no randomization described.
Observational community-based study comparing delivery locations, not an RCT.
Policy/conference document outlining Safe Motherhood Initiative priorities, not an RCT.
Abstract describes qualitative study about Episcopal priests identity work - completely unrelated to TBA training or maternal health.
Community randomized trial but intervention is nutrition counselling through multiple channels. TBAs are one channel but not the focus of training comparison.
Methodological paper about statistical tests for meta-analyses, not about TBA training.

Includes a cluster-randomized controlled trial component (Neonatal Resuscitation Program) where birth attendants were randomly assigned to receive training or not. Compares trained vs untrained birth attendants.
Validation study of women's reporting accuracy of obstetric complications, not an RCT about TBA training.
Cross-sectional survey of TBAs knowledge, attitudes, and practices. Not an RCT.
Has intervention and non-intervention areas but randomization not clearly stated. Focuses on misoprostol administration, not TBA training comparison.
Editorial/commentary piece about neonatal mortality epidemiology, not an RCT.
Cluster randomized trial but intervention delivered through Lady Health Workers working WITH TBAs. Primary focus is LHW training, not TBA training comparison.
Validation study of verbal autopsy methodology for neonatal deaths, not an RCT about TBA training.
